name: Kurokawa Mariko
source: The leader of the group which bullies Tsuyoshi , and who is also a daughter of a major group's CEO. Instead of fighting herself, she sends her underlings, especially [url=/c22266]Yuuka[/url] to deal with Tsuyoshi .
